title: CI pull_request path filters: copilot-*.yml workflow edits skip the heavy build and test workflows
answers: Why didn't build-wheel or typescript CI run on my PR that only edits a copilot-*.yml workflow?
How do I stop a heavy test workflow from triggering on Copilot workflow file changes?
Which GitHub Actions workflows ignore changes under .github/workflows/copilot-*.yml on pull requests?
body:
Path: Pull-request CI triggers for the build and test workflows (build-wheel, cross-version-tests, examples, fs2db, master, r, tracing, typescript under .github/workflows) are gated by each workflow's on.pull_request.paths-ignore list; the chokepoint is the `on:` block of each file.
Rule: `.github/workflows/copilot-*.yml` is listed in `on.pull_request.paths-ignore` of those eight workflows, placed immediately before `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. A PR whose changed files all match this glob does not start those workflows. Keep the entry in the same position in any workflow that gets a similar ignore list, and leave push, schedule and workflow_dispatch triggers unchanged.
Constraints: paths-ignore only suppresses a run when every changed file in the PR matches an ignored pattern, so a PR that also touches code or other files still runs all eight workflows. Does not apply to workflows outside that list, and does not change what runs on push to master.
applies: Applies to PR CI triggers in .github/workflows; scope is the eight listed build/test workflows and the copilot-*.yml glob.
says: Heavy build and test suites did not run on my automated assistant workflow change.
Skip long test suites when pull requests only modify assistant automation configurations.
Why are package building and integration tests skipped on my pull request?
Do not trigger expensive test suites when updating automated helper workflows.
Pull requests touching only assistant automation files should avoid running heavy test pipelines.
search: Pull-request triggers for eight heavy build and test workflows in .github/workflows configure on.pull_request.paths-ignore to skip runs when changes only match .github/workflows/copilot-*.yml. The ignored glob is placed directly before .github/workflows/docs.yml across build-wheel, cross-version-tests, examples, fs2db, master, r, tracing, and typescript. Push, schedule, and workflow_dispatch triggers remain unchanged. Workflows are suppressed only when every changed file matches an ignored pattern, meaning PRs modifying code or other unignored files still execute all eight workflows.
